scope: Read every remaining_human_scope and retained_inputs; independently classify all 242 historical records and retain three explicitly delegated current count records.
formal_proof_assumption: The underlying Lean proof is fully checked and correct. D is exclusively uncertainty in human interpretation/identification of the source.

category_key.A: Direct published-theorem application with its scoped hypotheses checked; inherited applications are identified explicitly.
category_key.B: Elementary/moderate reconstruction or exact conditional assembly; status distinguishes proved from still to write.
category_key.C: Substantial arithmetic/analytic/geometric reconstruction remains (or an explicitly optional internal proof).
category_key.D: Unresolved human source meaning, route applicability or same-object/source-to-instance bridge.

applicability_key.RH+GRH: A required residue in the requested combined RH and unrestricted Dirichlet-GRH reconstruction, or a source producer for it; target_scope explicitly distinguishes Case-III-only full-GRH residues from the 2-power-order/RH specialization. No claim that every alternative producer is necessary.
applicability_key.optional: A stronger predicate, internal proof of an accepted published theorem, or alternative source route not required by the selected sufficient route.
applicability_key.closed-in-stated-scope: The named portion is complete only with its stated hypotheses. Open inputs remain in scope_components/frontier_ids where applicable.

mapping_semantics: frontier_ids locate obligations semantically; they are not by themselves new checked dependency-graph edges.
A compound source record can have closed, optional and required scope_components. The primary category and applicability describe its principal retained scope; consult all components.

GLOBAL_HOST_WINDOW now denotes a closed HX implication. Count-bearing records map there only as a path locator; count_subfrontiers identify its still-open VWinAt input. They are not marked closed by HX.
The terminal GLOBAL_TIED_SCALAR is recorded as B/root_ZW_in_progress pending the root proof and review; no additional independent arithmetic-gap supplier is introduced.

D does not assert that source initialization with zero or empty fields is wrong. It asks which original source object satisfies the exact later consumer and whether the predecessor stronger demand is actually needed.
The three DA29 current count records are explicitly delegated, not silently omitted. Earlier compound count records remain independently dispositioned by their updated remaining scopes.

KA5/KA6 remove Case III only for fixed target characters of 2-power order, including the principal-character RH specialization. Arbitrary Dirichlet characters with nontrivial odd-order part still retain Case III, SeedIVAlt and Ctx3 ProModAlt; each affected record says so in target_scope.
All ten missing inherited IDs receive stable audit-only aliases; original_id remains null. Every supplied original ID is preserved byte-for-byte.
No inherited file or record is modified. Original scopes and retained inputs are included verbatim, with a canonical full-record hash.

count_v030_provenance.scope: KA1-KA4 close exact PropGK/CorGK/CountI aggregation; KA5-KA6 only remove Case III for fixed 2-power-order targets.
